title: Should Students Wear Uniforms?
text:
Many people think that students should wear school uniforms. In my opinion, uniforms are a good idea. Students do not have to think about what clothes to wear every morning. Uniforms also make all students look equal.

However, some students believe that uniforms limit self-expression. They say that clothes are a way to show who you are. I agree that this is important, but I still think school uniforms are better for most schools.

questions.text: According to the writer, what is one benefit of school uniforms?
options: Students do not have to decide what to wear every morning

questions.text: What do some students say about school uniforms?
What can the reader infer about the writer's opinion?
options: The writer thinks uniforms are a bad idea
The writer thinks uniforms are mostly a good idea
The writer does not care about uniforms
The writer has never worn a uniform

questions.text: Why does the writer mention students who disagree?
options: To show that other opinions are worth considering before giving a final view
To prove that all students want uniforms
To say that the writer has changed their mind
To ask the reader to vote on the issue

paragraph_translations: Wielu ludzi uważa, że uczniowie powinni nosić mundurki szkolne. Moim zdaniem mundurki to dobry pomysł. Uczniowie nie muszą każdego ranka zastanawiać się, co ubrać. Mundurki sprawiają też, że wszyscy uczniowie wyglądają równo.

Jednak niektórzy uczniowie uważają, że mundurki ograniczają wyrażanie siebie. Mówią, że ubranie jest sposobem pokazania, kim się jest. Zgadzam się, że to jest ważne, ale nadal uważam, że mundurki są lepsze dla większości szkół.
